# b1_demo_timeline

Draws the records of its data source as consecutive blocks on one time axis — the scenes of a run in order — with their cue markers, and the playhead of a media player.

## Data binding
Target of a **Data** link from a data source whose rows are ordered scenes: **durationField** (default `durationMs`) sizes a block, **cuesField** (default `cues`, a `{ name: offsetMs }` object) places the ticks, `title` labels it, `hasClip` greys out a scene that was not recorded.

## Working with a player
**playerObject** names the instance of a `b1_media_player` on the same screen. The timeline then shows where playback is and seeks the player to the start of a scene when the scene is clicked. Without it the timeline is static.

## Create with
Instantiate the shared master `DemoFactoryRunTimeline` next to a `DemoFactoryRunPlayer` and link the run-scene data source to it.
label: Demo Timeline
objectTypeDescription: The scenes of a recorded demo run on a time axis: one block per scene sized by its duration, cue markers inside each block, and the playhead of a media player on the same screen. Project-owned, studio-specific type of the Demo Factory Studio (b1-demo-studio, issue #17).
